title: Fractal Footwork
generation_prompt: Original all-ages liquid drum-and-bass instrumental for a one-or-two-key rhythm game, around 172 BPM with a clearly countable four-beat bar. Start with a nimble three-note marimba-synth motif, a clean punchy two-step breakbeat, rolling sub bass and bright chord stabs. Use varied ghost-note snare answers and crisp hi-hat transients without harsh distortion; at the midpoint strip to a new descending plucked melody with a half-time-feeling bass response, then rebuild into a lively finale that transforms the opening motif. Make one evolving 128-second stereo composition with distinct sections and audible accents suitable for rhythm charts. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings or known melody.
cover_prompt: Generate a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original album cover for duohertz track Fractal Footwork, a family-friendly drum-and-bass rhythm-game song. Bold high-contrast comic collage using near-black ink, warm ivory paper, coral red and electric cyan with a few yellow sparks. Main motif: TWO interwoven zigzag footstep-like sound paths splitting into crisp smaller fractal fragments then snapping back into a shared diagonal rhythm; fast broken-beat energy, angular cut-paper shapes, rough halftone and ink texture. Distinct from discs, circles, sky, racing cars or city imagery. Readable as a tiny thumbnail, playful but not childish. No people, shoes, text, letters, numbers, logo, characters or imitation of any existing game.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Fractal Footwork square artwork into a HORIZONTAL social card for duohertz. Retain its original pair of interwoven coral and cyan zigzag sound paths, smaller fractal rhythm fragments, near-black and warm-ivory halftone print texture. Recompose the energetic paths on the RIGHT two-thirds, with calm high-contrast dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp, fully legible English lines on the left: 'duohertz' all lowercase, and 'Fractal Footwork'. No other words, letters, numbers, people, shoes, logo, city, or existing IP. Original all-ages electronic music poster.
